* 1 x [Stone Hammer](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26442)

blends.name: Wood Club
blends.desc:
**Wood Club**
A crude weapon fashioned from a sturdy log, this wood club can deliver a devastating blow to enemies. It is heavy and unwieldy, but it can be effective in a pinch.

To craft Wood Club, you need to hold:
* 1 x [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)

blends.name: Rough Leather
blends.desc:
**Rough Leather**
Transformed through a process involving water and raw hide scraps, the resulting material becomes a durable and adaptable resource. With its essential functionality and ability to enhance crafting recipes, it adds depth and versatility to your adventures.

To craft Rough Leather, you need to hold:
* 1 x [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)
* 1 x [Stone Hammer](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26442)

blends.name: Journeyman
blends.desc:
**Journeyman**
Journeyman have acquired basic proficiency in combat, gathering, and crafting after honing survival instincts and acquiring some practical skills. Though they are still learning and improving, they are well on their way to becoming skilled in their field. A Journeyman's skills and knowledge grow as they gain experience and knowledge in the wilds.

Journeyman can claim Journey Pack every certain period.

*To upgrade your Commoner to Journeyman you need to hold:*
- [Bone Needle](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26448)
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism.*

blends.name: Hide Sandals
blends.desc:
**Hide Sandals**
Simple footwear made of animal hide, designed to protect the feet from rough terrain and provide some warmth. They can be fashioned from scraps of hide and tied together with plant fibers.

For sewing Hide Sandals, you need to hold:
- [Bone Needle](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26448)
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism.*

blends.name: Hide Pants
blends.desc:
**Hide Pants**
These pants are made of animal hide and provide additional protection for the legs. They can be fashioned from scraps of hide and stitched together with plant fibers.

For sewing Hide Pants, you need to hold:
- [Bone Needle](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26448)
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism.*

blends.name: Hide Shirt
blends.desc:
**Hide Shirt**
A basic garment made of animal hide that provides some protection against the elements and minor injuries. It can be fashioned from scraps of hide and stitched together with plant fibers.

For sewing Hide Shirt, you need to hold:
- [Bone Needle](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26448)
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism.*

blends.name: Bone Needle
blends.desc:
**Bone Needle**
Small tool crafted from animal bones and used for sewing and stitching various materials. It is a useful tool for survival in the wilderness, allowing for the creation of clothing and other fabric-based items.

To craft Bone Needle, you need to hold:
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)
- [Stone Hammer](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26442)

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism.*

blends.name: Stone Axe
blends.desc:
**Stone Axe**
A heavy and efficient tool made from a large stone head attached to a sturdy wooden handle, used for chopping and shaping various materials in the wilderness.

To craft Stone Axe, you need to hold:
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)
- [Stone Hammer](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26442)
- [Stone Pickaxe](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26445) 

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism*

blends.name: Stone Pickaxe
blends.desc:
**Stone Pickaxe**
A durable and versatile tool made from a sturdy stone head attached to a wooden handle, used for breaking and mining various materials in the wilderness.

To craft Stone Pickaxe, you need to hold:
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)
- [Stone Hammer](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26442)

blends.name: Stone Hammer
blends.desc:
**Stone Hammer**
A heavy tool with a flat surface and pointed end made from a solid piece of stone, used for breaking and shaping hard materials such as rocks and minerals.

To craft Stone Hammer, you need to hold:
- [Stone Knife](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26441)

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism*

blends.name: Stone Knife
blends.desc:
**Stone Knife**
A sharp and sturdy tool made from a sharpened piece of stone, used for cutting and preparing materials in the wilderness.

You might need to craft [Grass Twine](https://neftyblocks.com/c/twilightrpgs/blends/blend.nefty/26440) for this craft.

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism*

blends.name: Grass Twine
blends.desc:
**Grass Twine**
A durable and versatile material that is created by spinning dried grass. It can be used for a wide range of applications, including crafting tools, repairing items, and constructing structures.

*You will need [Twilight Player](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/twilightrpgs/drops/176923) to gain access to all collection mechanism*
